releases.name: v0.1.3 — Launch profiles and model cycling fix
releases.body:
## New
- Launch-screen profile indicator with Build/Plan model previews.
- Click, Ctrl+Shift+M, and /mode change the selection without leaving the launch screen or creating sessions.
- Start session with the selected profile using the button or /start-profile.

## Fixed
- Profile cycling now updates the full visible model, provider, and reasoning variant instead of leaving a stale model in the composer. Manual model overrides remain unrestricted afterward.

## Notes
- Typing a normal prompt directly on the launch screen still uses the configured defaultMode. Use the explicit start action to apply a different launch selection.
- 19 unit tests, typechecking, and live TUI checks passed, including an 80×24 terminal.

## Install
```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-session-profiles@0.1.3
```
